name: real-calendar-desktop
description: Real Calendar desktop app for macOS and Windows (Tauri)

scripts.build:release: npm run sync && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.release.conf.json
scripts.build:store: npm run sync && tauri build --no-bundle --config src-tauri/tauri.release.conf.json && tauri bundle --config src-tauri/tauri.microsoftstore.conf.json --config src-tauri/tauri.release.conf.json
